title: nmea0183: Add VTG sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for VTG messages.

* It uses the existing dissector for the fields.
* Report incorrect fixed text
* Report an expected but missing field

### Tested

This pcap contains valid and invalid variants of VTG sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/a700ad34a5e69b8b60a50f7d405f3a25/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with that capture.

notes.body: If the blurb does not add any useful information it should be left empty - NULL.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16944/diffs?diff_id=1106128761&start_sha=07cf961f82a7c1f2264f792a608287ceb9e4ad68#a9ffc441fbed9aea396851239fda70a9da8933ef_1470_1470)

It does inform about the sentence ID of the field, but that is already on the screen in another location. The docs state that it is used in a man page, but I am not sure what that means.

I added another commit which removes the blurb if it is just a rewording of the (name + sentence ID). Are the other blurb text what you expect?

Hi,

I think the prtactise have been to leave the field empty if nothing esential is added by the blurb text, checking readme.dissectors:

## blurb (FIELDDESCR)

This is a string giving a proper description of the field. It should be at least one grammatically complete sentence, or NULL in which case the name field is used. (Please do not use "").

It is meant to provide a more detailed description of the field than the name alone provides. This information will be used in the man page, and in a future GUI display-filter creation tool. We might also add tooltips to the labels in the GUI protocol tree, in which case the blurb would be used as the tooltip text.

I think that's what it's saying. Not sure what manpage the text is refering to. Maybe the filtyer reference?

I don't have any strong opinion on blurb text just wanted to point out that we currently mostly leave it empty if it does not add anything valuable.
